parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs indicated for cardiovascular disease. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno. Filter where max_phase_for_ind equals 4 and mesh_heading equals 'cardiovascular disease'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind ascending.
